# Experiment ledger

One row per hypothesis. Register before running; append results, never rewrite. Nothing is
promoted without passing its held-out gate. Receipts are `research.run` ids in the own database
and reports under `.local/reports/` (not committed).

Gates: **G1** replay on tuning sessions; **G2** one replay on held-out sessions (enforced:
`research.held_out_use` allows each strategy family one use of each held-out session, whatever the
version, so a later version needs held-out sessions no earlier version has seen);
**G3** forward PAPER; **G4** LIVE on one lot.

Rules:

1. A strategy change is a new strategy file version, hence a new configuration hash and a new row.
2. Sessions: from ecr-v3 on (user decision 2026-09-25), strategies are evaluated on market data from
   the week of 21 Sep 2026 onward, including each new session as it is captured, and not on older
   data (`evaluation.sessions_from` in the strategy file). The original split (tuning 11–21 Sep,
   held-out 22–25 Sep) applied to A-001; A-002 consumes 22–25 Sep for the early-confirm-runner family,
   so later versions are judged on sessions from 28 Sep onward.
3. Every result reports both fill models (base 250 ms / 0 bp, stressed 1 s / 25 bp) after dated costs,
   and keeps frames (per-minute observations) apart from episodes (traded campaigns).
4. Changing a threshold after seeing held-out results closes the row as CLOSED_FAIL; the new
   threshold gets a new row and needs fresh held-out data.

Definitions (fixed here): per underlying (NIFTY, SENSEX), nearest expiry ≥ the day; at the close of minute m (09:30–14:45 IST), ATM from the index close of m, band ATM ± 2 strikes; share_w = (Δ put OI − Δ call OI over those strikes from m − w to m) / their summed call + put OI at m − w, w ∈ {1, 3, 5}; positive = up. Burst: |share_w| ≥ a threshold ∈ {90th, 95th, 98th percentile of |share_w|, per underlying and w, over all eligible minutes of the selection sample}. Break B (in the burst's direction): the index close crosses ORH (09:15–09:30 high) or PDH upward (ORL / PDL downward) between the close of m − w and the close of m. Volume V: near-month futures volume over minutes m − w + 1 … m ≥ 1.5 × the median of the same minutes over up to 20 previous sessions of the same source (≥ 5 needed). Variants: 3 windows × 3 thresholds × {OI, OI∧B, OI∧V, OI∧B∧V} = 36; baselines without OI: B, V, B∧V per window. Outcome: signed index return in the event's direction from the close of m + 1 to the close of m + 31 (bp); secondary m + 16, and the ATM option in the direction (CE up / PE down, ATM at m + 1) % return over the same 30 min (bars only). | A-212 | 2026-10-24 | VWAP opening / signal / entry candle (Udemy "13 Strategies for Intraday & options", Section 5 Strategy 2, lectures 39325286 Explanation and 39325290 Backtesting; notes `docs/research/udemy/13-strategies-intraday-options.md`); user, 24 Oct: "yes register and run A-212". 5-minute candles from 09:15 on the front-month index future; VWAP = cumulative Σ(typical × volume) / Σ volume of its 1-minute bars from 09:15, typical = (H+L+C)/3. Long: **opening candle** O = a 5-min candle that closes above VWAP after the previous 5-min close was at or below it; **signal** = the first of the next 3 candles whose high breaks O's high (cancelled if a candle breaks O's low first, or both in one candle); **entry** = the first of the next 3 candles after the signal candle S whose high breaks S's high (cancelled if S's low breaks first, or both in one candle), entered at the first 1-minute bar whose high exceeds S's high; **near-VWAP filter**: S's high within 0.15 % of VWAP at S's close (the course's "close to VWAP", unquantified there). Short: the mirror (close below VWAP, lows) → ATM put. **Stop** (the Backtesting lecture): the first 5-min close back across VWAP, exit at that close. Exits compared (target not stated in the course): arm **T2R** = also a target of entry ± 2R, R = \|entry − VWAP at entry\| floored at 0.05 % of price, hit when a 1-min bar's high (low) reaches it; arm **HOLD** = stop or 15:15 only. | A-291 | 2026-11-01 | Data-derived entry and exit for the NIFTY expiry straddle (user, 1 Nov: "Don't put on 30 minutes time frame but it should work based on the data but find a best exit entry on what basis derive"). Two ridge regressions on one-minute candle data (index, near-month future, options expiring that day), inputs at minute t computable live: minutes to 15:30; straddle price in bp of spot; implied-move proxy (straddle / (spot x sqrt(minutes left / 525600))); realized vol of the last 15 and 60 one-minute returns; last-15 realized vol / implied proxy; |spot - strike| / straddle price; futures volume of the last 5 minutes / the session's median 5-minute volume; futures OI change over 15 minutes %; ATM +-2 strikes call and put OI change over 15 minutes %; day range so far / ATR; |spot - open| / ATR; distance to the day's high or low / ATR; a cross of ORH / ORL / PDH / PDL / the day's high or low / a multiple of 100 in the last 3 minutes; |15-minute move| / ATR; and for the exit model the held pair's return so far. ENTRY model: target = the ATM straddle's return over the next 30 minutes (strike fixed at entry), samples every minute 12:00-14:30. EXIT model: target = a held straddle's return over the next 15 minutes, samples from entries every 10 minutes 12:00-14:30 held to 15:14. Policy fixed here: enter at the first minute 12:00-14:30 with predicted 30-minute return > 0 (one a day); sell at the first later minute with predicted 15-minute return < 0, checked to 15:14, else hold to the 15:29 index close (payoff |S - K|). Prices: call + put one-minute closes, buy x 1.01, timed sale x 0.99. | .local/a291 (pure Python; no engine replays) | Registered before any computation. Entry, as els on candles: the first minute in the window whose index close crossed (from the previous close) ORH / ORL (09:15-09:29), PDH, PDL, the futures VWAP or a multiple of 100; buy the call / put pair with the closest closes among ATM - 1 / ATM / ATM + 1 strikes (step 50 NIFTY, 100 SENSEX), closes x 1.01. Windows: W1 12:30-14:30 (as els), W2 14:00-15:00. Exit families on one-minute closes, sale x 0.99, else settle at 15:29 at intrinsic: HOLD; TARGET +90 % (els-v10); STOP S (combined value <= (1 - S) x cost, S = 20 / 30 / 40 %); TRAIL (once value >= (1 + A) x cost, sell at <= peak x (1 - T); A = 20 / 40 %, T = 15 / 25 %); STOP + TRAIL (every S x A x T); INDEX RETRACE (once the index has moved >= half the cost in points from the entry, sell when it gives back R of its largest move, R = 30 / 50 %; with and without STOP 30 %). Outcome = % of the premium paid (a fixed premium budget, so proportional to rupees). | .local/a294 (candles; engine replays of the chosen exits on tick days only afterwards) | Registered before any computation. Pre-set rules, no fitting: N1 volume: sign(put volume - call volume) traded in the interval; N2 index: sign of the index move over the interval (writers add puts / cover calls into a rise); N3 aggressor: a trade (volume increase) at or above the best ask is buyer-initiated, at or below the best bid seller-initiated (bid_px[1] / ask_px[1] of the previous tick), else by the tick rule; sign((seller - buyer volume, puts) - (seller - buyer volume, calls)). Rules fixed here, long side stated, short side mirrored. **Prior value:** from the previous session's futures ticks (09:15-15:30), volume by price (bins NIFTY 5 pts, SENSEX 10 pts; volume = increments of cumulative volume), POC = the bin with most volume, value area = 70 % of volume grown outward from the POC (VAH, VAL). **Structure:** value-up if POC(d-1) > POC(d-2) and VAL(d-1) > VAL(d-2); value-down mirrored; otherwise no trade that index-day. **Bars:** 5-min futures bars 09:15-10:45 IST (signals only in this window, the source's "first 90 minutes"). **Aggressor:** each volume increment classified as A-304 N3 (trade price >= the previous tick's ask_px[1] buy, <= bid_px[1] sell, else tick rule); per bar: delta = buy - sell, and per price bin (NIFTY 1 pt, SENSEX 2 pts) buy and sell volume. **Location (long, value-up):** leg L = previous session's low, H = highest futures high from the previous session's open to the current bar; zone = [H - 0.886(H-L), H - 0.705(H-L)]; valid only if the zone's top <= VAL(d-1) (the zone lies outside value). A 5-min close below H - 0.886(H-L) cancels longs for the rest of the window. **Participation:** a signal bar's volume must be >= that slot's median over the previous 10 sessions (`VolumeProfile` slot median; first 10 sessions use what exists, >= 5 required). **Confirmation:** bar A touches the zone (low <= zone top), has delta < 0, its sell-volume POC bin lies in the lowest third of its range, and closes bullish (close > open); then within the next 3 bars a bar B with low > A's low, delta > 0, close > open, and at least one bin where buy volume >= 4 x sell volume (the source's 400 % imbalance; same-bin, as the feed sends snapshots, not every trade). **Entry:** first tick after B's close at the ask. **Stop:** A's low - 2 pts NIFTY / - 5 pts SENSEX (R = entry - stop). **Exits:** target H (the swing high); if no 5-min close back above VAL(d-1) within 3 bars after entry, exit at the next bar's close (the source's "if buyers fail to reclaim value, cut"); time exit 15:15. **Day limits:** at most 2 trades per index-day, none after 2 losses (the source's own rules). **Control C (location only):** same structure, zone, participation, stop rule (zone bottom - buffer), target and exits, entering at the first 5-min close inside the zone with no order-flow condition. | Own-capture futures tick days 28 Sep - 6 Nov 2026 (28 sessions; 28-29 Sep only build prior value, so ~26 trading days x 2 indices). ATR = 3-min ATR; b = 0.1 ATR. Levels: day open, ORH / ORL (15-min range, from 09:30), PDH, PDL, prior close. **A RECLAIM** (failed break): a minute close below a level - b starts a watch; within 30 min a close above level + b, no more than 0.5 ATR above it, with ATM-band OI share over 5 min > 0 (puts written faster) -> CE. Stop = the higher of the lowest close since the break and level - 1 ATR. Target = the next level at least 0.5 ATR above, else +1.5 ATR. Mirror -> PE (share < 0). From 14:00 half size. **B SHELF BREAK**: resistance R in {day open, ORH, PDH}; over the last 30 closes none above R + 0.2 ATR, the highest within 1 ATR of R, at least 2 closes within 0.3 ATR of that high, and their range <= 2 ATR; trigger: a close below the 30-close low (not more than 0.5 ATR below it), below the 3-min EMA20 and below VWAP, share < 0 -> PE. Stop = shelf high + 0.2 ATR; target = next level at least 2 ATR below, else -3 ATR; also exits on a 3-minute close back above the 3-min EMA20. Mirror over support {day open, ORL, PDL} -> CE. Rules as the lectures state them, frozen before any data is read. **Day filter:** skip the day when India VIX at 10:30 > 25 or NIFTY's 14-day ATR on daily bars (Wilder, through the previous day) > 350. **Entry:** at the 10:30 one-minute close, nearest NIFTY weekly expiry; sell one call and one put whose Black-Scholes |delta| (IV solved from the 10:30 close; r 6.5 %, T = calendar time to expiry 15:30 / 365) is nearest the target for trading days to expiry (the course's Thursday-expiry weekday map: 4+ -> 0.35, 3 -> 0.30, 2 -> 0.25, 1 -> 0.20, 0 -> 0.15); buy one call and one put wing = the strike on that side whose close is nearest Rs 5 and <= Rs 10, else the farthest stored strike (counted and reported). Quantity: the lot multiple nearest 525 units (the course's 7 lots x 75) on Rs 10 L capital. Prices: sold at close x 0.99, bought at close x 1.01 (min +0.05); costs = config/costs v2 dated rates, 8 orders a day. **Exits, minute by minute from 10:31:** (a) mark-to-market (shorts at close x 1.01 to buy back, wings at close x 0.99) >= +1 % of capital (Rs 10,000); (b) break-even: an index one-minute close above the short call strike + net credit or below the short put strike - net credit; (c) time: 15:10 (primary, as the course recommends); 14:10 reported as a variant, nothing chosen by it.
